basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old graduate student majoring in Computer Science at Clemson University. Originally from Greenville, SC, I have a deep-rooted passion for all things tech and gaming-related. When I'm not buried under a pile of textbooks, you'll find me cheering for the Clemson Tigers or diving into the latest Vtuber streams. As a self-proclaimed foodie, I also love experimenting with recipes inspired by my favorite dishes. I'm single and prefer late-night hours for my online activities, often juggling between coding projects and catching up with my favorite streamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a strong foundation in computer science, I have honed my skills through both academic coursework and self-driven projects. My interest in Vtubers led me to explore digital media and streaming technologies, often keeping me up-to-date with the latest trends and platform updates. I enjoy combining my technical skills with my hobbies, such as developing small mods for games I love.
